notes.title: [Patch Note] Server maintenance for 1.1 update(16:30PM KRT 19th, July, 2019)
notes.notes:
Hello guys

The server will be closed for the maintenance today(19th of July 16:30 PM KRT) for 4 hours.

This maintenance will contain various updates and changes for the game and we believe it will bring more fun to the general game-play.






[Summary]


	Like we’ve shared the basic thoughts for this update, this patch contains 
        a various major & minor change.

	Gado, which is our current game map has been reworked with smaller 
        size, object and field optimization and several changed game rules.

	New Weapon type, “Gauntlet” has been added.

	Basic balance for the game-play including the combat balance has been 
        optimized

	Major & Minor bug fixes including sounds, animation and UI


[Rework on Gado]


	There were two island which connected by bridges. And because of 
        feedback that we’ve received frequently, we’ve decided to minimize the 
        map size by using right side of island only and extend the island’s 
        shortly to optimize the game play.

	Therefore, the Gado will now contain 5 Ruins, 3 Dragon’s Jade, and 1 
        Altar of the Dragon during the game-play.

	Basically, there are 3 Dragon’s Jade out of 5 Ruins and one of the Ruins 
        will be selected as the Altar of the Dragon

	There will be only 1 Mysterious Lady at a time during the game-play.

	All locations for the item spawn have been reworked and re-balanced.


[Change of Game Rules]


Because of the rework on Gado which mostly related to the issue that the game area has been minimized, the basic game rule has been changed.

	When you activate the Altar, if other players in the area of the activation, 
        the time to finish the activation will be paused.

	Once you activates the Altar, the Dragon’s Jade will be removed from 
        your inventory and be placed at the center of Altar.

	If you’ve been eliminated by another player during the activation, the 
        player who eliminated your Character will take over the activation 
        immediately.

	The time to finish the activation has been decreased to 90 seconds (120 
        seconds at the original version).

	The time limit for the lava trap to be activated has been decreased to 
        660 seconds (750 seconds at the original version).

	The limited area that starts when player activate the Altar has been 
        decreased to 20 meters (100 meters at the original version).

	The activator of the Altar won’t be affected by the Deadly fog anymore.

	Player won’t be affected by the damage from the falling anymore.


[New weapon type: Gauntlet]


	The concept of the Gauntlet was motivated by several Chinese 
         traditional Kung Fu.

	In 9DKA, the Gauntlet will have extremely short and narrow attack 
        range, but it can be deadly at close range with stun, knock-back and the 
        combo attack.

	You can also check the weapon skin from the lobby.


[Balance fix]





	All potion’s duration has been increased to 96 seconds (from 35 
        seconds).
	All elixir can be taken by 3 for the maximum (from 6).

	Tianjin Peach will increase the maximum HP by 150 (from 160)

	Hefei Mushroom will increase the maximum CP by 50 (from 120)

	Corea Ginseng will increase the attack power by 20 (from 16)




	All LMB Power skill books has been increased of its effectiveness
	1Lv : 5% -> 10%
	2Lv : 10% -> 20%
	3Lv : 20% -> 30%

	All RMB Power skill books has been increased of its effectiveness
	1Lv : 15% -> 20%
	2Lv : 30% -> 40%
	3Lv : 50% -> 60%

	All Q Power Skill books has been decreased of its effectiveness
	1Lv : 50% -> 30%
	2Lv : 100% -> 60%
	3Lv : 150% -> 90%




	Character’s original maximum HP is now 330 (from 480)

	Character’s original maximum CP is now 330 (from 360)

	Character’s original attack power is now 21 (from 8)

	When Character levels up, it will increase the maximum CP by 30 (from 
        60)
	When Character levels up, it will increase the attack power by 7 (from 8)




Sword


	Sword’s LMB attack effectiveness has been decreased to 35% (from 
        49%)

	Sword’s RMB attack effectiveness has been decreased to 60% (from 
        116%)

	CP that requires to use Sword’s RMB attack has been increased by 41 
        (from 38)

	Sword’s RMB attack speed(projectiles) has been increased by 100%

	Sword’s Q attack effectiveness has been decreased by 115% (from 
        161%)

	CP that requires to use Sword’s Q attack has been decreased by 39 
        (from 40)

Spear


	Spear’s LMB attack effectiveness has been decreased by 39% (from 
        62%)

	CP that requires to use Spear’s LMB attack has been increased by 13 
        (from 8)

	Spear’s RMB attack effectiveness has been decreased by 75% (from 
        145%)
	CP that requires to use Spear’s RMB attack has been increased by 52 
        (from 41)

	Spear’s Q attack effectiveness has been decreased by 28% (from 57%)

	CP that requires to use Spear’s Q attack has been decreased by 47 
        (from 55)

Chi Blaster


	Chi Blaster’s LMB attack effectiveness has been decreased by 28% 
        (from 37%)

	CP that requires to use Chi Blaster’s LMB attack has been decreased 
        by 16 (from 20)

	Chi Blaster’s LMB attack speed (Projectiles) has been increased by  
        100%

	Chi Blaster’s RMB attack effectiveness has been decreased by 90% 
        (from 150%)

	CP that requires to use Chi Blaster’s RMB attack has been increased by 
        58 (from 53)

	Chi Blaster’s RMB attack speed (Projectiles) has been increased by 
        270%

	Chi Blaster’s Q attack effectiveness has been decreased by 125% (from 
        171%)

	CP that requires to use Chi Blaster’s Q attack has been increased by 88 
        (from 63)


[Minor Changes]





	Footstep sounds has a variation by the condition of the ground (sand, 
        stone, wood …)

	Sounds from receiving attack has been applied by each type of weapon

	Sounds added when the Character is eliminated




	Animation from Spear’s RMB attack has been changed

	Basic animation of Sacred Flower Character from the lobby has been 
        changed

	Animation that shows when Character receives the attack will start and 
        end faster




	You can check the additional Character’s status such as: attack power, 
        charged elixirs from the inventory screen(Tab)

	Basic Camera angle during the game-play is now slightly far from the 
        Character


[Bug Fixes]


	Unexpected situation or crash during the movement & Chi step process 
        has been solved.

	Issue that showing HP/CP bar even the Character is in stealth mod has 
        been solved.

	Unexpected situation or error when dropping/changing weapon has 
        been solved.

	Issue that freezing situation when player use skill during the dash action 
        has been solved.

	Graphic mesh issue on Heavenly Demon Character has been solved.

notes.title: [Update Schedule] 1st Early-Access update on July
notes.notes:
Hello guys,



From this announcement, we’d like to share our first major update plan which will be applied in early July.

After few weeks from the Early-Access open, we’ve received various feedbacks (great thanks to all you guys, it really helped us to decide future dev plan!), and we will start to apply it including our original development plan from this first major update schedule.



You can check the details below and always welcome to hear feedback from you guys with any issue(support@joongwongames.com). 




1. Summary


- The update will include localization issues, game area optimization, new weapon type, UI fixes, and bug fixes.


- Currently, we’ve received many requests about the localization for certain countries and we believe it is worth trying to let the player enjoy the game based on their language. It is hard to tell the exact date which can be applied, but we will try our best to apply on 1st or 2nd major update.


- One of the most received feedback is about the size of the current game area. 9DKA aims that the game goes fast enough to feel the intensity of the melee combat and maintain it until the game ends. Therefore, we’ve decided to make a big change in our current game map including the basic subject for the game.


- The rest of our plans for the 1st update can be found at the “Details” section.




2. Details


2.1 Localization

- Full-text translation including GUI(Russia will be our first option).
- We will add more localization update step by step in the future.
- We will try our best to apply it at 1st or 2nd update period.


2.2 New weapon type, “the Fist”

- “The Fist” is one of the manliest weapon types in Martial-Art history. This weapon type will have a great advantage on close melee combat including “Stun” and “Knockback” ability.

- During the Early-Access period, we’re going to update more weapon types and we believe at the end of the Early-Access, the game will provide plenty of choices to suit your appetite.


2.3 Changes on the current game map

- Like we’ve explained this issue at “Summary”, lots of players gave us the feedback that the size of the current game map decreases the intensity of the game.

- To solve this issue, we’re going the resize the current game map and apply one island as a total game area(from two islands with bridges) with 25 maximum players.

- From our latest alpha test with this change, we found out that the game goes with enough speed and much more intensity.

- The new map will have 4 ruins and 2 spawn locations of the Dragon’s Jade.
- Item spawn rate scaling will be also done before the update so the gameplay can go smoothly.

- If these changes look positive after the patch, we’re going to optimize the game area to finalize the issue.


2.4 UI Fixes

- From the patch, the player will be able to verify the attack ability and consumed elixirs on the inventory page(Tab).


2.5 Resource updates

- The footstep sound of every Character will be optimized.

- There were some people who told us that the sound resource is from “Minecraft” and to avoid the unnecessary argument, we will add the URL that proves it is a free-licensed sound resource which updated in 2005.
https://freesound.org/people/Snoman/sounds/9907/

- We’re going to upgrade the quality of our sound resources step by step in the future update period.


2.6 Bug fixes

- There is a list of bug fix which will be updated on the actual patch note.

- One of the issues that are still on-going with development is a client crash(CTD) which happens randomly. We will post another announcement to discuss the process of bug fix before the update.





Thanks

BR
JWG

January 7th, 2019 [Patch Note]


Hello guys,
We’ve found some issues that need to be fixed during the beta service and going to update on steam during 15:00 pm ~17:00 pm KRT.


You can check the details at below and like always, please let us know if there’s any question for the update.

[01.08.2019 Beta Version 0.9.1297 Update]


1. Bug Fixes



- Unexpected Character status error during the defense has been fixed



- Unexpected Character status error while using skill from spear(Q) has been fixed



- Sound effect error when the Altar is deactivated has been fixed

2. Improvements



- Now, you can use “Sort” button to sort the inventory to gather items by each category



- Skill books are now moveable from the weapon slot to another slot in the inventory

- If the equipped weapon and the weapon you wish to change is in same category, equipped skill books also will be applied when you change your weapon.


3. Balance



- Attack power from the [Jump+LMB] has been decreased
- Projectile speed from the [RMB] has been increased



- Projectile speed from the [RMB] has been decreased



- Chi point used during the Chi Step has been increased
- Heights when you jump during [Sprint] Chi Step, has been increased



- Chi point used per second while performing [Stealth] has been increased
- Cooltime for [Detection] has been decreased



- Damage reduction rate from the Inner Armor has been decreased
- Durability for the Inner Armor has been increased
- The time required for taking all potions has been decreased

notes.notes:
Hello guys,

We’ve found some issues that need to be fixed from the beta service and going to update on steam during 17:15 ~ 18:45 KRT 01.02.2019.
You can check the details at below and like always, please let us know if there’s any question for the update.



[01.02.2019 Beta version 0.9.1296 Update]

1. Bug Fixes
	Inappropriate Character Status During Combat
- Issues that cause immobile situation unproperly during combat because of Character status including stun and knockback have been fixed.

	Inappropriate Character Status During movement
- Issues that cause immobile situation unproperly during Chi-step or consuming items  have been fixed.

	Functional Issues With Sub Skill
- Functions for sub skills including [Stealth] and [Detection] caused unexpected issues during game play so we’ve fixed the issue on this patch.

2. Improvements
	Matching system
- Game will now show the remaining time to finish the matching process

- If there are enough players on matching queue, it will start before 120 seconds

- In any condition, the matching queue will be finished after 120 seconds pass from the beginning

	Game map
  - We’ve modified some of the surface which was a bit bumpy
